description.ncbi_summary: This gene encodes a member of the potassium channel family of proteins. The encoded voltage-gated ion channel allows the outward flow of potassium ions during plasma membrane hyperpolarization in sperm. Opening of this channel may be regulated by calcium ion levels. Homozygous knockout mice that lack the related mouse gene exhibit male sterility. Alternative splicing results in multiple transcript variants. [provided by RefSeq, Dec 2015].

uniprot_function.text: Testis-specific potassium channel activated by both intracellular pH and membrane voltage that mediates export of K(+) (PubMed:23129643, PubMed:24670955, PubMed:36649421, PubMed:38267364, PubMed:9452476). Represents the primary spermatozoan K(+) current. The channel underlies a pH-triggered membrane hyperpolarization during the process of sperm capacitation, as sperm encounter the alkaline environment near the ovum in the female reproductive tract, thereby playing an essential for male fertility (PubMed:34980136, PubMed:35551387, PubMed:36649421).
